fields.Name: AIUsageHourly
fields.UserQuestion: What is our hourly AI usage and cost broken down by model, agent, user, and scope?
fields.Description: Primary hourly aggregation of AI usage facts. Computes model-call counts, token volumes, latencies (P50/P95), cache reads, and spend (by currency) across all dimensional attributes.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Live analytical query over [__mj].vwAIUsageFacts, one row per UTC hour x dimension set x CostCurrency. Optional start/end ({{ start | sqlDate }}, {{ end | sqlDate }}) select whole hours: every hour that overlaps [start, end) is returned complete, by rounding start down and end up to the hour and range-filtering the base RunAt column (sargable on IX_AIPromptRun_RunAt). The hour is derived from RunAt by truncation and exposed as HourBucket (DATETIME) plus BucketStartUTC / BucketEndUTC. Parallel parents are counted in ParallelParents and excluded from every other measure. Latency percentiles are PERCENTILE_CONT window functions collapsed with MAX (SQL Server 2019+).
